about: Hurco TMX8MYi turning centre, self-made in Blender (sources/tmx8/build_tmx8.py) from Hurco's product photos of the TMX8MYSi / TMX8MYi and the record's specs: gunmetal-grey enclosure with silver frames on a black base; the left panel with the HURCO plate, vertical 'TMX8MYi' lettering, two air gauges and a service hatch; the large sliding door with its round-cornered window onto the headstock, 8 in chuck holding a bar and the 12-station live-tool turret; the right panel's cabinet door; the MAX5 pendant hung off the right front from its silver post (screen with a chuck graphic, keys, e-stop, jog) with the signal tower on the post and the blue coiled air hose below; the chip conveyor along the left side with its head, motor, chute, legs and casters; the electrical cabinet doors behind. Door closed: the work zone shows through the glass.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled against Hurco's product photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked

source.made: self-made in Blender from public dimensions and photos; build script and .blend beside it
